notes: D2 anonymous usage ledger. Once per UTC day each install aggregates a whitelist-exact report (model names, request counts and token totals — never prompts, files, paths, URLs or credentials) and POSTs it to a Cloudflare Pages Function that upserts it into a free-tier D1 database; the Models section of the public site renders the aggregates (installs, requests, seven-day daily bars, per-model and per-scenario breakdowns) from GET /api/stats. Reporting is collect-by-default per the owner's ruling — the product seed ships it on, the new console Settings card is the opt-out switch, and module defaults stay fail-closed so test clones can never send. The /api/visits counter migrated from Workers KV (1,000 writes/day) to D1 (100,000 rows/day) with its historical count seeded once, so the public number continues instead of restarting; the KV binding stays provisioned for instant rollback.
